<!-- Un solo riquadro dinamico per il video -->
<div id="video-wrapper" style="display: none; margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px;">
  <h4 id="video-title" style="margin-top: 0;"></h4>
  <video id="main-video" width="100%" height="auto" controls>
    <source id="video-source" src="" type="video/mp4">
    Il tuo browser non supporta il tag video.
  </video>
</div>


<script>
// Lista dei video associati agli ID
const videoData = {
  'video1': {
    title: 'Video 1: Introduzione',
    src: 'https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-videos/flower.mp4'
  },
  'video2': {
    title: 'Video 2: Tutorial',
    src: 'https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-videos/flower.mp4'
  },
  'video3': {
    title: 'Video 3: Demo',
    src: 'https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-videos/flower.mp4'
  }
};

let currentVideoId = null;

function showVideo(videoId) {
  const wrapper = document.getElementById('video-wrapper');
  const video = document.getElementById('main-video');
  const source = document.getElementById('video-source');
  const title = document.getElementById('video-title');

  // Se clicchi sullo stesso bottone, nascondi il video
  if (currentVideoId === videoId && wrapper.style.display !== 'none') {
    wrapper.style.display = 'none';
    video.pause();
    currentVideoId = null;
    return;
  }

  // Aggiorna titolo e sorgente video
  title.innerText = videoData[videoId].title;
  source.src = videoData[videoId].src;
  
  // Ricarica il player con il nuovo video
  video.load();
  wrapper.style.display = 'block';
  currentVideoId = videoId;
}
</script>
